OfficeCategory.OFFICE_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION: The state comptroller (auditor of state) is the chief financial officer of the state of Indiana. The comptroller has four primary duties: accounting for all of the state’s funds; overseeing and disbursing county, city, town and school tax distributions; paying the state’s bills; and paying state employees.
